ALTER procedure EpMA.svProjectAll ( @_ApplicationId int, @_ActorId int, @_CultureId int,
@IncludeProjects bit = 1, @IncludeMandates bit = 1, @IncludeArchives bit = 0, @IncludeOnHold bit = 0, @ForAllActor bit = 0,
@ProjectTypes nvarchar(128) = '' ) as begin
declare @types table (val int) insert into @types (val) select part from Neva.fSplitString(@ProjectTypes, ',');
WITH XMLNAMESPACES ('http://james.newtonking.com/projects/json' as json), projects as ( select distinct p.ProjectId from EpMA.tProject p left outer join EpMA.tTeamMember t on t.ProjectId = p.ProjectId left outer join @types pt on pt.val = p.ProjectType where (@ForAllActor = 1 OR Ep.fApplicationIsAdmin(@_ApplicationId, @_ActorId) = 1 OR t.UserId = @_ActorId ) AND (@ProjectTypes = '' OR pt.val is not null) ) select "@json:Array" = 'true', p.ProjectId, p.Code, p.ProjectType,
p.IsMandateSigned, p.IsArchived, p.IsOnHold, p.CalendarId, p.SearchId,
p.CreatorId , p.Creator , p.CreationDate,
CustomerId = p.CustomerEntityId, CustomerName = ISNULL(c.CompanyName, i.FirstName + ' ' + i.LastName),
LongListLength = (select count(*) from EpMA.tListMember lm where lm.ProjectId = p.ProjectId), ControlListLength = ( select count(*) from EpMA.tListMember lm left outer join Ep.vDbObjStatus ds on ds.DbObjId = lm.ListMemberId AND ds.Row = 1 -- only lalst AND ds.ResCultureId = @_CultureId AND ds.ParentSystemKey = 'MA.ListMember.Declined' where lm.ProjectId = p.ProjectId and ds.DbObjStatusId is null ),
TaskTotal = (select count(*) from EpTask.tDbObjTask dt where dt.DbObjId = p.ProjectId), TaskCompleted = (select count(*) from EpTask.tTask t inner join EpTask.tDbObjTask dt on dt.TaskId = t.TaskId where dt.DbObjId = p.ProjectId AND t.IsDone = 1), ( -- -- 'top 1' would have worked here but (since 2017, August 18th) this is auto corrected to top (1) -- and this test would require an <AutoCorrectedText></AutoCorrectedText> element... -- select top (1) ds.[DbObjStatusId], ds.[Date], RepoValueName = rv.Name, RepoPath = rv.Path,Title = REPLACE(ds.[Title], '{RepoValue}', ISNULL(rv.Value, '')) from [Ep].[tDbObjStatus] ds left outer join Ep.vRepoValue rv on rv.RepoValueId = ds.RepoValueId AND rv.ResCultureId = @_CultureId where ds.DbObjId = p.ProjectId order by Date DESC FOR XML PATH ('LastStatus'), ELEMENTS, TYPE ), Team = ( select "@json:Array" = 'true', t.UserId, u.DisplayName, t.IsResponsible from EpMA.tTeamMember t inner join Ep.tUser u on t.UserId = u.UserId where t.ProjectId = p.ProjectId order by t.IsResponsible DESC, u.DisplayName FOR XML PATH ('data'), ELEMENTS, TYPE ), Ep.fvDbObjLabel(p.ProjectId)
from projects u inner join EpMA.vProject p on p.ProjectId = u.ProjectId inner join Ep.tDbObj d on d.DbObjId = p.ProjectId
left outer join EpCrm.tCompany c on c.CompanyId = p.CustomerEntityId left outer join EpCrm.tIndividual i on i.IndividualId = p.CustomerEntityId
where d.ApplicationId = @_ApplicationId AND( @IncludeProjects = 1 AND p.IsMandateSigned = 0 OR @IncludeMandates = 1 AND p.IsMandateSigned = 1 ) AND ( p.IsArchived = 0 OR @IncludeArchives = 1 ) AND ( p.IsOnHold = 0 OR @IncludeOnHold = 1 )
order by d.CreationDate DESC FOR XML PATH('data'), root('data'), ELEMENTS, TYPE
end
Test.Description: For xml WITH both namespace and CTE (from Maxime :))
'next value for' is specifically handled as an expression.
